pages.text: Jewelry is crafted, then worked. Put a pearl and its binding in the crafting grid in the piece's shape: you get an unworked piece. Place it on a Blacksmith's Anvil and hit it with the hammer (or let an Autohammer do it) until it is done. The pearl and binding set how many hits it takes.
pages.title: Creation

pages.text: $(li)Ring: seven bindings in a ring with the pearl at the top middle$(li)Bracelet: two bindings in the top corners above four pearls in a U$(li)Necklace: seven pearls in a ring with the binding at the top middle$(br2)Crafting a finished piece with one pearl of another colour changes it to that material and keeps its enchantments.
Jewelry is repaired on the Blacksmith's Anvil like any damaged item, at a cost in experience. Pieces whose durability runs out stay in the mirror but do nothing until repaired.
pages.title: Repair
